## activate_shine_on_focus

Activates the shine effect on the focus with the given id. Focuses that are completed cannot have an activated shine effect. Note that tooltips for this effect are only shown in debug mode.

作用域：`country`

```ts
"activate_shine_on_focus"(value: string): void;
```

## activate_targeted_decision

Activates targeted decisions or mission, ignoring its normal trigger conditions, cooldown and fire only once. Cannot activate if active in interface.

作用域：`country`

```ts
"activate_targeted_decision"(value: { "target": CountryRef; "decision": string } | CwtNode): void;
"activate_targeted_decision"(value: { "target": StateRef; "decision": string } | CwtNode): void;
```

## add_relation_rule_override

Adds an override rule to the country's relation to other countries. If there are multiple applicable overrides for a rule, then they are combined using AND logic for positive rules (e.g. can_access_market) and OR logic for negative rules (e.g. can_not_declare_war).\n The description of the effect is based on the trigger or the target country.The description when using the rule override is based: on the target country; the trigger at the time of effect evaluation; or the provided usage_desc.\n The following rules are currently supported: can_send_volunteers, can_access_market Alternative 1:\nadd_relation_rule_override = { \n target = GER # [Required] Target country usage_desc = REASON_DESCRIPTION # [Optional] usage description can_not_declare_war = yes # [Required] \n}\n Alternative 2:\nadd_relation_rule_override = { \n trigger = is_democratic_country # [Required] Named trigger usage_desc = DEMOCRATIC_COUNTRY # [Optional] usage description can_not_declare_war = yes # [Required] \n}\n"

作用域：`country`

```ts
"add_relation_rule_override"(value: CwtNode): void;
```

- [Config/effects_toa.cwt:7](https://github.com/cwtools/cwtools-hoi4-config/blob/master/Config/effects_toa.cwt#L7)
